name: union-find
description: A Disjoint Set Union (DSU) / Union-Find data structure with path compression and union by rank. Efficiently tracks which elements belong to the same partition, merges partitions, and checks connectivity. Used in Kruskal's MST, cycle detection, and dynamic graph connectivity.
aiPromptContext: Use this block for efficiently managing and querying disjoint sets. Critical for Kruskal's minimum spanning tree, Percolation theory, offline dynamic connectivity, and network clustering problems.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Optional initial capacity for integer-indexed elements.
